text:
Maya P: heads up — onboarding jobs in us-west-2 are creating ephemeral subnets that spin up a VPC endpoint per customer. we're seeing a big spike in vpc-flowlogs -> audit-exporter traffic and it pushed GPU node provisioning from ~3m to ~15m this morning.

Jordan: ugh. link to grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/egress/gpu-onboard?orgId=1 — notice KMS decrypt QPS spikes during endpoint creation. NATGW egress bills also jumped.

Samir: this matches the keystore logs i saw. each ephemeral endpoint triggers a grant creation call chain and a couple of S3/audit writes. KMS grants + flowlogs = extra 2–3s per node, but the aggregation + exporter backpressure is what killed the queue.

Lee: any rough cost delta? rough calc from yesterday's run: extra audit egress ~1.2GB per onboarding => ~ $0.03 but multiplied by 800 onboards in a day = ~$24, plus NATGW data egress ~ $120/day when cluster churn is high. not huge individually but spikes cause throttles.

Maya P: the operational cost is less the issue than the provisioning SLA. customers expect Dedicated GPU pools to join within 5–7m. We're breaching SLO when many onboards run concurrently.

Samir: short term mitigation: we can queue ephemeral endpoint creation and reuse a shared ephemeral-logging endpoint per AZ for 10m windows. That would reduce flowlog fanout and KMS grant churn. downside: slightly broader audit surface for 10m.

Jordan: can we do a sampling hack in the exporter? e.g., when onboarding rate > X, sample flowlogs 1/N and mark with tag so we can backfill later. audit-bot: note — sampling requires product/COMPLIANCE signoff if it affects retention semantics.

Maya P: not comfortable with sampling without compliance ok. alternative: add an IAM boundary tweak so ephemeral endpoints assume a short-lived role that uses a static grant rather than creating new grants per endpoint. that should cut KMS calls.

Lee: hmm, role-boundary approach sounds promising. Ops cost: small infra change to keystore proxy to accept reuse token. work estimate ~2 engineer days plus canary. Security risk: need to confirm cross-account grant semantics for that pattern.

Samir: I'll sketch a proposal: 1) create per-AZ ephemeral-logging endpoint with a long-lived grant; 2) change onboarding flow to attach endpoint instead of creating one; 3) emit an audit tag with customer id so retention/query still works. This preserves full fidelity for queries while reducing churn.

Jordan: +1. also add circuit-breaker in exporter so if queue latency > 2s it backpressure-fails and we surface clearer metric to infra teams.

Maya P: assign Samir + Lee to prototype. tag compliance for a quick review: @audit-bot can you trigger a retention/impact summary for this pattern?

audit-bot: automated note — creating summary report for proposed per-AZ ephemeral endpoint reuse. ETA 2 business hours. Will include retention impact, KMS grant model, and required approval path.

Lee: thanks. i'll reserve a small canary pool in us-west-2 to test; will coordinate rollout plan + rollback knob. if we can shave provisioning back under 7m on canary, we do wider rollout.

Maya P: thanks team. followups: Samir to post PR draft in #eng-infra, Lee to create canary runbook, Jordan to add exporter circuit-breaker metric and dashboard. We'll reconvene after audit-bot report. :thumbsup:
